note: The current edition is branded 2025 Topps Inception (some shops list it as 2026 / 2025-26) and released June 19, 2026; there is no separate 2026 Topps Inception Baseball checklist. Base set is 125 cards: 1-100 regular plus 101-125 short prints, with RC-flagged rookies throughout; 7-card hobby boxes carry 4 base, 2 parallels, 1 autograph. Because of the late release, some price guides do not treat this as a true 2025-year rookie card product.
